enter the code from the access card
swipe the access card to open the server room

pick it up (E) and bring it to the guard

insert the module into the rack, power it up and press START below the drive bay
drag the portable generator here from the storage room and press E
works while the server has power
drag it onto the yellow marking, plug in the power cable and insert the module
opens the server room; the code is on the back
gives you the access card; hand him the archive drive
circuit breaker: E to switch on/off
insert into the server room fuse box — switch its breaker off first
insert into the port on the front of the server rack
drag it (LMB) to the power inlet by the fuse panel in the corridor and connect it there (E); fits through doors sideways

no fuse: switch the breaker off with an empty hand (pocket the fuse, 1–4), then insert it and switch on

pick up the plug (E), bring it to the server rack and plug it in

Generator too far — drag it here (6 m cable)

Hey! Stop right there! Who are you?
Electric shock! The breaker was on — the arc tripped nearby circuits.
pries locked doors open, rips off grilles — fast but loud
repairs torn lines, quietly unscrews grilles

server cable; if torn, repair it with a wrench, don't touch it

line break! Live up to the break, careful

second inlet: the generator can't run the lights and the server together
